content:
With this stormwight kit, you channel your [primordial ferocity](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.fury.level-10/primordial-ferocity) into the form of a wolf, becoming a fleet-footed hunter. [Vuken](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/kit/vuken) are tied to forests and open steppes, and this aspect is associated with the thunderstorm.

##### Signature Ability

###### Unbalancing Attack

*A wild assault forces your foe onto their back.*

| **[Melee](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/melee), [Strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike), Weapon** |               **Main action** |
|---------------------------|------------------------------:|
| **📏 [Melee](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/melee) 1**            | **🎯 One creature or object** |

**[Power Roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) + [Might](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/might):**

- **≤11:** 4 + M damage; A < WEAK[, prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone)
- **12-16:** 7 + M damage; A < AVERAGE[, prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone)
- **17+:** 9 + M damage; A < STRONG[, prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone)
